question: Consider the unit circle \(x^2+y^2=1\). The locus of a point \(P\) such that the tangents \(PA,PB\) at points \(A,B\) respectively of the circle are so that \(\angle AOB=60^\circ\), where \(O\) is the origin, is

options.A: a circle of radius \(\frac2{\sqrt3}\) with centre \(O\);
options.B: a circle of radius \(\sqrt3\) with centre \(O\);
options.C: a circle of radius 2 with centre \(O\);

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
